dedupe_keys.name: javna agencija republike slovenije za varnost prometa road datasets

description: JAVNA AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VARNOST PROMETA: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by JAVNA AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VARNOST PROMETA. Coverage: JAVNA AGENCIJA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA VARNOST PROMETA. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zbirka predlogov izboljšav na vertikalni in horizontalni prometni sign; Evidenca potrdil o opravljenem strokovnem izpitu presojevalcev varnost; Analize in pregledi stanja varnosti cestnega prometa; Seznam nevladnih organizacij na področju zagotavljanja prometne varnos. Formats seen: HTML, PDF, XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
